title: Fourier spectrum concentration
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\bbr$, and let $\epsilon,k\in\bbr$. The Fourier spectrum of $f$ is concentrated up to $k$ with error $\epsilon$ if its total Fourier weight on subsets of cardinality strictly greater than $k$ is at most $\epsilon$.
